purpose: verify learnability on the single transparent-geometry cell that passed the reliability-conditioned commitment-value gate
endpoint_requirement: Report high- and low-reliability evaluation bands separately, with primary and future completion, energy, collision and constraint endpoints.
decision_rule: Proceed to PSCR method design only if at least two training seeds show nonzero service at the terminal pilot validation; this establishes learnability only, not information-use or method superiority.
interpretation_boundary: Development calibration. The preceding transparent Q0 supports physical decision relevance but does not establish learned-policy behavior.
